# CN04 evidence register

Version: 1.1
Status: evidence-mapped production artifact

## Purpose
Pair physical objects, digital files, rights and oral-history prompts.

## Governing question
Which knowledge is absent from the file itself?

## Evidence spine
S08; S39; S40; S41; S42; S43

## Claim or field architecture
Identifier pairing; formats; storage; narration; access authority

## Production outputs

## Release gate

## Accessibility and rights
Captions, transcripts, keyboard behavior, visible labels, exact canonical records, and object-level implementation decisions are mandatory.
